full_judgment:
5. The appellate Court below on the other hand considered the case of Baburam Mondal Vs. Renuka Bala Roy Chowdhury and ors. (l960) 12 D.L.R. 517 and came to hold from the circumstances of the case that although the document was executed and registered without the consideration money being paid yet title did not pass due to the fact that the intention of the parties was otherwise and that the kabala was not acted upon. In that view of the matter the appellate Court below allowed the plaintiff's appeal and decreed the suit. 

 In the result, the appeal is dismissed. The judgment and decree of the appellate Court below are confirmed. There will be no order as to costs.
